name: Reuters Institute Report: Hespress tops most trusted news
snippet: The report, based on survey responses from 100,000 people in 48 countries, confirms Hespress’s leading position in Morocco’s digital news space. Weekly access to Hespress content reached 45%, with users visiting the site at least three times per week.
